dataset: Hillstrom MineThatData E-Mail (64000 rows). Arms: Womens/Mens/No E-Mail. 8 PRE-treatment features (recency, history_segment, history, mens, womens, zip_code, newbie, channel); outcomes visit/conversion/spend.
contrast: Womens E-Mail (T=1) vs No E-Mail (T=0); Mens arm dropped.
why_this_dataset: The clean version of Cookie Cats: every covariate is measured BEFORE the email, so adjusting for them is valid with no mediator caveat. Also lets us run the real-data UNOBSERVED-confounder bound (adjust WITHOUT the variable we confounded on).

established_ground_truth_RCT.note: Full-RCT diff-in-means = measurement of a real randomized experiment (not prediction).

design.mechanism: SELECTION, not reassignment. Every customer keeps real arm + real outcome; we choose who enters the analyzed sample with keep-prob depending on (arm, baseline spend).
design.confounder: h = standardized log1p(history)  (history = prior 12-month spend, PRE-treatment)
design.keep_probability: email arm: sigmoid(-beta*h)  [over-samples LOW spenders];  no-email arm: sigmoid(+beta*h)  [over-samples HIGH spenders]
design.intended_effect: email arm skews to low-history customers (who visit less); no-email skews high-history (who visit more). Naive diff-in-means is biased DOWNWARD -> toward the WRONG (negative) sign, opposite the true +4.5pp.

predictions_about_METHODS.naive_diff_in_means_confounded: SIGN WRONG (negative) or severely biased downward vs true +4.5pp.
predictions_about_METHODS.causal_adjust_WITH_confounder: SIGN RIGHT (positive) — recovers the true email lift.
predictions_about_METHODS.causal_adjust_WITHOUT_confounder_unobser: WRONG / badly attenuated — omitting the variable we confounded on reproduces the spike's S2 bound on REAL data.

honesty_caveats.constructed_confounding: Injected from real data — robustness demo on real outcomes + real PRE-treatment covariates, not a found observational set.
honesty_caveats.obvious_direction: The true email->visit effect is obvious/positive (unlike Cookie Cats). The test is methodological (recover sign under confounding), not counter-intuitiveness.
honesty_caveats.power_vs_breadth: 64k customers but ONE A/B contrast. Depth, not a cross-experiment accuracy claim.
